summary: Integration-readiness brief — annunimas-human-tenant: PASS for its declared project check, `git diff --exit-code HEAD --` (exit 0). The tenant contains local scan and missing-vault tests, but is not independently deployable: Cargo.toml:13-14 still binds it to Annunimas path dependencies, while docs/migration-notes.md:7-10 confirms live vault data and runtime ledgers were not copied and compatibility removal remains gated. Annunimas/annunimas-human: its project-specific compatibility check is `cargo test -p annunimas-human --test target_local` (docs/migration-notes.md:15); outcome in this bounded node is NOT RUN because that project is outside the approved root, so upstream compatibility is unverified here. Shared integration risks are the unresolved cross-project dependency seam, absent tenant runtime/data state, and lack of current upstream compatibility evidence. Recommended operator action: authorize and run the documented `cargo test -p annunimas-human --test target_local` check in the Annunimas project before approving integration or removing the compatibility seam.
